notes.subject: sɔgɔma ka nyɛ tigɛ
notes.rationale: שחר ka kɔrɔ literal ye 'ka sɔgɔma bɔ' ye; Barsa-kan fɛ 'min bɛ sɔgɔma ka baara daminɛ'

notes.subject: רצון
notes.rationale: disɛ/ɲɛ-juguya walima Yawe ka sɔn — bayɛlɛmabaga bɛ cogoya wɛrɛw ta

notes.subject: יבקש/דרש
notes.rationale: daɲɛ fila don don sira kelen kan, contrast in kɔ

notes.subject: fɔli
notes.rationale: רעה ka kɔrɔ ye jugu ye, a tɛ 'malheur' dɔgɔmannin ye

translation: Min bɛ sɔgɔma ka nyɛ tigɛ ka ɲini, o bɛ disɛ sɔrɔ; nka min bɛ fɔli ɲini, fɔli bɛna a bolo na.

tokens.gloss: min bɛ sɔgɔma ka nyɛ tigɛ
